# 每日金融简报 11-24 12:00 ET

### 美国政治
- 众议院外交事务委员会民主党高级议员要求 Jensen Huang 举行公开听证，此前其被曝与多人有风流关系（[The Hill](https://thehill.com/policy/technology/6240078-top-house-democrat-calls-for-public-hearing-with-jensen-huang/)）
- 特朗普支持 Huang 复职，多名国会议员表示将追查，共和党人对此施压（[The Guardian](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNV1R5Tm5OLXZqMWFfZXF0aS1QbHdrRThCalFxektGNWk3RHcwd3dWdE53MHlFM1ppeWxJMWxoTzhVY3FHZG1nSVpjRTZIQTEtck1zS095Y3dNVXdCNUNrcE9NSW03RkJiSnM3OVVKVVlKUU9OMkxEelpxXzZCY19URDZ0UUwtUQ?oc=5)、[雅虎财经](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/huang-faces-3-camps-of-gop-skeptics-ahead-of-congressional-grilling-164400869.html)）
- 特朗普表示支持对信用卡利率设定上限，MarketWatch 称假日购物者不应指望其落地（[MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/trump-is-open-to-capping-credit-card-interest-rates-but-holiday-shoppers-shouldnt-bank-on-it-yet-34260705?mod=mw_rss_topstories)）
- 教育部对一个弗吉尼亚学区冻结联邦资金，该学区被报道未审查约 500 名员工（[The Hill](https://thehill.com/homenews/education/6239925-doe-withholds-virginia-school-funds/)）
- 特朗普将于周二向 Rudy Giuliani 颁授总统自由勋章（[The Hill](https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/6240011-trump-to-award-giuliani-medal/)）
